📄 Description

A streamlined modpack focused on what matters most—smooth performance and convenient gameplay. This pack combines essential optimization mods to eliminate lag with carefully selected quality of life improvements that make Minecraft more enjoyable without unnecessary complexity. Perfect for players who want vanilla Minecraft enhanced, not overwhelmed.

---

📦 Included Performance & Quality-of-Life Mods

This modpack includes a carefully selected set of optimization, visual enhancement, and utility mods to create a smoother and more enjoyable Minecraft experience.
